sentences.text: The defect was fixed in a hotfix for the dispatch service, which the postmortem records as shipped in v3.3.2 on 2026-03-19.
The defect was a connection pool leak in the dispatch service that was introduced in release v3.3.1.
Connections that timed out while a robot was switching access points were not returned to the pool, so the pool slowly shrank until it reached its limit of 512 connections.
The hotfix returns connections that time out while a robot switches access points to the pool.
